events.title: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 4 released
events.summary: Samsung began selling the Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 4 — Snapdragon 8+ Gen 1 and improved multitasking on foldables.
events.about: Foldables forced Android developers to handle resizable and multi-window layouts on flexible displays. Snapdragon 8+ gen 1 and improved multitasking on foldables.

narrative.whyChosen: The Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 4 pushed foldable Android hardware into the mainstream.
narrative.whyImportant: Foldable form factors require adaptive [UI] patterns beyond fixed phone screens.
narrative.problemSolved: Phones were locked to a single rigid screen size and aspect ratio.

events.title: U.S. CHIPS and Science Act signed into law
events.summary: President Biden signed the CHIPS and Science Act on August 9, 2022 — allocating $52 billion in subsidies to rebuild domestic [semiconductor] manufacturing and fund advanced chip R&D.
events.about: The act responded to pandemic chip shortages and geopolitical dependence on Asian fabs. Intel, TSMC, and Samsung announced U.S. fab projects; developers felt the impact through supply-chain stability and renewed government investment in quantum, AI, and advanced packaging — reshaping hardware roadmaps for datacenters and edge devices.

narrative.whyChosen: CHIPS was the largest U.S. industrial policy bet on semiconductors in a generation.
narrative.whyImportant: It accelerated onshore fab construction and R&D funding for next-gen processors.
narrative.problemSolved: Global chip shortages and supply-chain risk exposed dangerous concentration of advanced manufacturing in East Asia.
